meta.name: Heron Twin harness v0

scrollEngine.heron: window never scrolls; .body-inner overflow:hidden height:100vh; .main-inner is the Lenis wrapper AND ScrollTrigger scroller (scrollerProxy); lenis 1.1.5 lerp 0.1
scrollEngine.madarek: window scroller + window.__mdrkLenis (Lenis 1.1.5, HERON_LENIS_PARAMS); seek via lenis.scrollTo(y,{immediate:true}); fallback native window.scrollTo

notes: Heron section selectors verified live 2026-02 (probe-1440.json): the <home-*-wrap> custom elements are zero-height hosts; the rendered blocks are div.home-*-wrap / div.cta-wrap / div.footer-wrap.
Madarek selectors verified in frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx + probe-1440.json.
Madarek is RTL; heron is LTR — horizontal geometry is mirrored by design, so this harness compares VERTICAL geometry (heights, gaps, type scale) and per-step visual diffs.

sectionMap.note: Madarek top of page, .hro- classes, section before #statement
verified: .wy-section band sits inside the #product region
heron cta is div.cta-wrap (the <home-cta-wrap> host is zero-height)

verdictRule: PASS = all four metrics within thresholds; FAIL = any metric beyond 2x its threshold; PARTIAL = anything between
